---
title: "Lorenz System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& y - x \\
\dot{y} &=& -xz+x \\
\dot{z} &=& xy - az
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=0.08$ and initial condition $(-2,2,2)$.
